note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP clinical note, but I don’t yet have the transcript or the DDx JSON. Please provide both items exactly as described:

- The full clinic visit transcript (doctor–patient conversation).
- The Differential Diagnosis JSON (DDx) produced by the diagnostic agent.

What I will extract (for your awareness)
- Presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression
- Past medical history, surgeries
- Medications (with “dose/route/frequency not documented” if not provided)
- Allergies
- Social history (if present)
- Relevant exam findings and investigation results (only if in transcript/DDx)
- Working diagnosis and differentials (DDx items included only when consistent)
- Management, treatment, referrals, follow-up plans

Notes on constraints I will follow
- Treat transcript as primary source; use DDx only to enrich reasoning and differentials when consistent.
- I will not invent vitals, labs, or other facts not present in the transcript or DDx.
- If transcript and DDx conflict, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”
- Output will follow the exact SOAP structure you specified.

Please paste the transcript and DDx JSON and I will produce the structured SOAP note.
